facts.fact: 一群唱颂歌的人突然出现在 Scrooge 背后，人数多到像一支队伍
facts.anchor: Suddenly, there they were there, a whole fleet of them, a battalion!

facts.fact: 颂歌队唱的是正常圣诞颂歌，人人有红脸颊、穿着御寒、声音清亮
facts.anchor: All of them ruddy-cheeked and noisy, dressed for the cold and in fine voice, singing out loud and clear in the winter night.

facts.fact: 他们身上没有暖意，歌声也不再悦耳，变成刺耳尖叫
facts.anchor: No warmth emanated from them, none. Their voices soared, no longer sounding in the least bit melodic, but closer instead to a sequence of raucous screeches.

facts.fact: Scrooge 认出其中一些人是旧日生意场上的债户
facts.anchor: He recognised them from his old life, back when he had lent money and provided mortgages, alongside much else.

facts.fact: Peter Smithfield 曾是救济院执事，因赌债败落
facts.anchor: who had once been the beadle of a workhouse and whose gambling debts had brought him to ruin

facts.fact: Franklin Ross 超额借贷买房，本欲供一家人居住而那家人始终没来
facts.anchor: a house that he had purchased to accommodate a family which had never arrived

facts.fact: Old Ma Delaney 被 Scrooge 与 Marley 在七十一岁生日前两天赶出
facts.anchor: whom Scrooge and Marley had evicted two days before her seventy-first birthday

facts.fact: Scrooge 申称已赔偿所有死者家属并向城内城外慈善机构捐款
facts.anchor: I have made recompense to the families of each and every one of you. I have donated to every charity in the city and dozens beyond it.

facts.fact: Jack Winstanley 告诉 Scrooge 太迟了，永远都不够
facts.anchor: It’s too late, Ebenezer! And believe us when we tell you: it’s never enough!

facts.fact: Scrooge 宣告幽灵对他没有权力，只是记忆与怨恨
facts.anchor: You have no power over me,” said Scrooge. “You are nothing more than memory. Memory and spite.

facts.fact: Scrooge 承诺每一天都在偿还自己的债
facts.anchor: each day, I am paying down my debt!

facts.fact: 幽灵在他话音落下后消散如烟
facts.anchor: they all vanished into air, drifting away like so much quickly moving smoke

facts.fact: 众人散去后他脸上掠过一阵痛楚并试图掩饰
facts.anchor: A twinge of pain crossed his face, although he tried to hide it.

facts.fact: Scrooge 抓住门环铁在门上敲了三下
facts.anchor: took the door knocker and banged three times upon the door.

facts.fact: 屋内深处传来极轻极远的笑声
facts.anchor: From somewhere inside, very faint and far away, he heard the sound of distant laughter.
